headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Cloudflare's developer documentation spans 7,869 crawled pages with strong retrieval readiness (94.5 overall score, 90% chunkability). However, 43 confirmed broken internal links disrupt navigation, API reference coverage sits at only 56.92% across 2,975 detected API pages, and example reliability is critically low at 46.15%. Evidence backing for key claims reaches 61.93% (2,435 of 3,932 claims), while 10 links remain unverified due to authentication or rate-limiting. Overall confidence stands at 83.95%, with crawl coverage at 100% of the 7,955 in-scope pages.

key_findings.headline: Undocumented API operations
key_findings.business_consequence: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

key_findings.headline: Code/docs contract drift
key_findings.business_consequence: Track interface changes and enforce docs updates with report-first governance.

priority_actions.title: Fix all 43 confirmed broken internal links
priority_actions.why_this_first: Immediate trust and SEO win with minimal engineering effort, directly reducing user frustration and support tickets for navigation failures.

priority_actions.title: Implement automated testing and refresh cycle for code examples to lift reliability from 46.15% toward 80%+
priority_actions.why_this_first: Code examples are the highest-leverage onboarding asset; fixing reliability directly shortens time-to-first-success and reduces developer churn.

priority_actions.title: Close API reference coverage gap from 56.92% to 85%+ by auditing 2,975 detected API pages and generating missing usage docs
priority_actions.why_this_first: Incomplete API docs drive support volume and integration abandonment; closing the gap unlocks self-service adoption and enterprise deal velocity.

strengths: Excellent retrieval readiness (94.5 score) with 90% chunkability and 100% answerability, optimizing AI-assisted search and support deflection
Comprehensive crawl coverage at 100% of in-scope pages (7,869 of 7,955), ensuring audit completeness
Strong freshness metadata coverage at 93.46%, enabling users and systems to assess content currency
risks: 43 confirmed broken internal links create friction in user journeys, erode trust, and degrade SEO authority
API reference coverage at 56.92% leaves nearly half of API surfaces undocumented or poorly linked, increasing support burden and integration failure risk
Example reliability at 46.15% means over half of code samples may be outdated, broken, or untested, directly impacting developer time-to-value and product perception
61.93% evidence coverage for claims suggests ~1,500 assertions lack supporting links, code, or data, weakening credibility and onboarding confidence
limitations: External audit cannot verify content accuracy, correctness of code examples, or alignment with actual API behavior—only structural and linking integrity.
10 links blocked by authentication or rate-limiting were not verified; if user-facing, they may be broken but remain undetected in this audit.
Crawl excluded 1,155 trap URLs and 966 links by policy; issues in out-of-scope content (e.g., legacy subdomains, staging environments) are not captured.
automation_first: Deploy CI-integrated link checker to catch the 43 broken internal links (and future regressions) pre-publish, preventing trust erosion and SEO penalties with zero ongoing manual effort.

Establish nightly automated test harness for code examples across all 7,869 pages to lift the 46.15% reliability estimate above 80%, directly reducing developer onboarding friction and support load from broken samples.

Build API reference coverage monitor tied to OpenAPI specs to track the 2,975 detected API pages and alert when coverage drops below 85%, ensuring new endpoints ship with usage docs and preventing the current 56.92% gap from widening.
